# examples/menu/panel throws on load and renders nothing

**Claim it first:** comment on this issue before you start, and check the open pull requests for one that already points here. We merge the first approve-worthy PR (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`, point 3). This row comes from #19920, where @bercedev has first pick on its rows.

## Context

Welcome! This is one row of #19920, split out so that its fix closes its own ticket. You need a fork, Node and the dev server (`npm run server-start`); no Agent OS, Docker or AI tooling.

A headless sweep of every example page on 2026-10-20 found `examples/menu/panel` throwing during construction and rendering nothing. It still does on `dev` `f5decee2c0`. Open `http://localhost:8080/examples/menu/panel/index.html` and the console shows `TypeError: me.layout?.applyChildAttributes is not a function`. The page fails the same way at `13.2.0`, so this predates 13.3.

## The Problem

The stack runs from `src/container/Base.mjs:723` (`me.layout?.applyChildAttributes(item, index, true)` inside `insert`) up to `src/menu/Panel.mjs:58`, where `afterSetList` (`:57`) calls `this.add(value)`.

## The Architectural Reality

- A container creates its layout instance from the `layout` config during construction (`src/container/Base.mjs`).
- `afterSetList` can run before that has happened. `layout` is then still a plain config object, which the optional chaining does not guard against: it skips only `null` and `undefined`.

## The Fix

The likely cause, which the fix confirms or corrects: `menu.Panel` inserts its list before its container has a layout instance. Either add the list once the layout exists, or let `insert` defer the child attributes until it does. Fix it in the engine.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `examples/menu/panel` loads with no page error and renders its menu.
- [ ] AC-2: a unit test in `test/playwright/unit/` fails before the fix and passes after it.

## Out of Scope

- The other rows of #19920, which have their own tickets.
